card.name: Lab assay methods and analyzer lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words right before a laboratory assay or method name, such as the colon after "assay" or the "the" after "determined by". Also the commas closing manufacturer names in lists of lab analyzers.

modes.label: Analyzer list commas
modes.description: Comma after a manufacturer in parentheses inside a list of lab analyzers.

modes.label: Before assay method
modes.description: A colon or linking word just before the named assay technique.

modes.label: Interference by method
modes.description: "the" or "using" before an immunoassay or binding technique in interference statements.
modes.example: interferes with the measurement of methotrexate concentration<< using>> immunoassays.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated, so it mainly marks that a technique name comes next.
card.plain: It lights up just before the name of a lab test method or analyzer is given.
